newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices ease.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices ease.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel prices moved lower on Tuesday, with differentials failing to rebound following a sell-off in the futures market, traders said.
"I just appears that everybody is full up," one Group Three trader said of a lack of buying interest in the market

Differentials were largely unchanged in early discussion, leaving prices to track a 0.25 cent a gallon decline in February heating oil and more than 0.50 cent a gallon drop in front-month unleaded gasoline futures midday.
Unleaded gasoline was bid even with NYMEX February unleaded in Chicago and 3.75 cents under the print in Group Three for all January timings, traders said.
Chicago January low sulphur diesel was talked 5.0/4.75 cents a gallon under NYMEX February heating oil, with high sulphur bid 6.0 cents a gallon under the print.
Group Three low sulphur diesel was talked 4.50/4.25 cents a gallon under the print, with high sulphur 8.50 cents a gallon under, traders said.
Traders were looking to the weekly stocks estimates for trading signals, but said plentiful stocks in the Midwest should keep differentials unchanged to weaker in the days ahead.
